turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Why did my son see a zero before I got a call?
I made one point, and it was a question. Answer it.
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Then put the facts on the table. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
My child doesn't lie, and you've just accused him with nothing in front of me. On what basis, Hale? Because from here it's the principal's office next.
